evals.expected_output: A registry-URI-aware workflow using returned model URIs, immutable numbered versions, authorized tags/aliases, explicit quality gates, idempotent automation, and compensating rollback.

evals.prompt: Register a ResponsesAgent in Azure Databricks Unity Catalog and canary its new version on a custom model serving endpoint with 10 percent traffic and UC observability.
